explication: UI Toolkit is a UniFi network management and monitoring web application: users open the unified dashboard or a focused tool, which exposes status, analytics, tracking, security monitoring, and firewall lockdown workflows. The four tool applications are mounted by the shared FastAPI app; they use common UniFi, persistence, caching, and realtime facilities. README capabilities are retained, but unsampled router and scheduler internals limit confidence about their precise calls, so those links are omitted where not evidenced.
